headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Tracking runs to Dec. 31, where the odds are limited war 66%, escalated 13%, MOU-style 14% and comprehensive 7%. Trump confirmed a second minor US strike on a Qeshm air-defence site, but one defensive hit on a military target is limited war, not the resumed campaign that would fire tw_us_campaign; Qatar says the talks continue and Iran still holds to its seven conditions, so the odds hold.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
Iran offers a concrete cut in enrichment capacity, in text or on the record
